name: Whacked!

features.name: Half-symbol xWays
features.description: Two or four half symbols that pay in full.

review:
Whacked! is a 5x3 mob slot where every win loads more bullets into a cylinder, and once all six are loaded, the feature fires. xWays expand into two or four half-sized symbols, which pay the same as full-size ones.

Three scatters start Whacked Spins. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with an 11,912x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
